conditions.cpu_normalization: process kernel+user CPU / measured wall / logical processors
conditions.executable_file_cache: each executable stream read immediately before launch; warm filesystem cache
conditions.autonomy: same saved state and wall schedule; random action mix is not deterministic
conditions.repetition: real UI menu rest/resume cycles, confirmed in private fixture files; deterministic frame-cache stress is separate
conditions.peak_private: maximum sampled PrivateUsage; OS peak commit is reported separately
conditions.leakage: observed growth/slope and post-loop settling only; a short run cannot prove absence of leaks
